title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1 NE SHITJE TEK MINE PEZA!
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 ne nje nga rezidencat me te reja te zones!
Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 104 m2 organizohet ne sallon- kuzhine, dy dhoma gjumi, tualet dhe ballkon me dalje nga salloni dhe dhoma matrimoniale.
Apartamenti ka punime te cilat jane realizuar me standart te larte, ekstra nga kompania e ndertimit.
Orientim Jug-Lindje i cili mundeson ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites.
Kjo mundesi eshte zgjedhja ideale si per banim, ashtu dhe per investim afatgjate, fale lokacionit strategjik me akses te shpejte ne zonat me te kerkuara te qytetit.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni.
title_en: APARTMENT 2+1 FOR SALE IN MIN PEZA!
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in one of the newest residences in the area! The apartment with a total area of ​​104 m2 is organized in living room-kitchen, two bedrooms, bathroom and balcony with exit from the living room and matrimonial room. The apartment has works that were carried out to a high standard, extra by the construction company. Orientation South-East which enables natural lighting throughout the day. This opportunity is the ideal choice for both residence and long-term investment, thanks to the strategic location with quick access to the most sought-after areas of the city. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us.
